meta.label: Cerebras Inference
meta.description: Chat completions served on Cerebras wafer-scale hardware. Supports streaming, tool calling, structured outputs, reasoning and image inputs.

params.name: credential_mode
params.label: Credential mode
params.description: Shared: one admin-managed key for everyone on this connection. Individual: every user supplies their own, so Cerebras billing and rate limits attribute per user.

params.name: base_url
params.label: Base URL
params.description: Change this only for a Cerebras dedicated endpoint. Must include the /v1 suffix.

params.name: model
params.label: Model
params.description: Exact model ID, e.g. gpt-oss-120b. Free text rather than a dropdown so it never goes stale as the Cerebras catalog changes. Current catalog: https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/models/overview

params.name: supports_images
params.label: Force image input support
params.description: Known vision models are detected automatically. Tick this only for a newer or custom vision model the plugin does not recognise. When neither applies, image prompts fail with an explicit error instead of a confusing 400 from the API.

params.name: reasoning_effort
params.label: Reasoning effort
params.description: Leave on 'Model default' unless you need to force it. 'None' disables reasoning on models that support that.

params.name: include_reasoning_in_text
params.label: Include reasoning in the answer
params.description: Off (recommended): reasoning tokens are recorded on the trace only. On: they are prefixed to the completion inside <thinking> tags.

params.name: request_timeout
params.label: Request timeout (s)
params.description: Applies to reading the response as well as connecting.

params.name: max_retries
params.label: Max retries
params.description: Retries on 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff, honouring Retry-After.

params.name: extra_body
params.label: Extra payload fields
params.description: Advanced. Merged into the JSON request body, e.g. prompt_cache_key or parallel_tool_calls. Values that look like JSON are parsed; everything else is sent as a string.
